summary: Collects the ASN.1 definitions of the component matching rules for LDAP and X.500 directories into one properly identified ASN.1 module. That lets other specifications import those definitions into their own ASN.1 modules. It updates the earlier rules in RFC 3687 in form rather than adding new behavior.

eli5.summary: A rulebook was scattered over many pages. This puts the rules together in one clearly labeled chapter so other books can point right to it.

questions: ldap component matching rules asn.1 module
